question: Can a service worker replace its own script from locally held bytes when the origin server is gone?

update_with_origin_down.rejected: TypeError: Failed to update a ServiceWorker for scope ('http://127.0.0.1:47311/p2/') with script ('http://127.0.0.1:47311/p2/sw.js'): An unknown error occurred

meaning: a service worker cannot replace its own script from local objects: the update fetch bypasses the worker (served v1 from the origin although the worker would answer v2) and fails when the origin is gone; the active script stays. The worker script is therefore an immutable seed for as long as the origin server is absent
